precepts.text: Polluting His name was not mispronouncing a name but breaking His commandments, for He magnified His word above His name.
precepts.point: They caused every man to bring his servant and handmaid back into subjection to be servants and handmaids again.

note.label: Jeremiah 34: Liberty Proclaimed and Then Revoked

precepts.why:
“But ye turned and polluted my name”. Polluting his name was not mispronouncing a name. David shows what the Lord sets highest: “for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.”

He magnified his word above his name, so his name is polluted by breaking his commandments. They had made a covenant before him in the house called by his name, and then caused every man his servant and every man his handmaid to return into subjection. Breaking the commandment that a Hebrew servant go free in the seventh year is how they polluted his name.
